title: Kraken Hurricanes and Golden Knights Bettman's beast beating a city as the Castle Crumbles #smallpoems
summary: Kraken Hurricanes and Golden Knights Bettman's beast beating a city as the Castle Crumbles #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Kraken
Hurricanes
  and Golden Knights
Bettman's beast
  beating a city
as the Castle
Crumbles
#smallpoems
